**Or as a one-liner loop for all Wave 1:**

```bash
for task in T01-prompt-config-and-loader T04-benchmark-types-and-loader T07-judge-and-codex-cli T09-cli-registration T10-budget-tracker; do
  echo "=== Executing $task ==="
  forge implement "docs/superpowers/specs/autoresearch-tasks/${task}.md" --autonomous --dry-run && \
  forge reset --force && \
  forge run --autonomous --yes
  echo "=== Done: $task ==="
done
```

**Full execution order (all 5 waves):**

```bash
# Wave 1
for task in T01-prompt-config-and-loader T04-benchmark-types-and-loader T07-judge-and-codex-cli T09-cli-registration T10-budget-tracker; do
  forge implement "docs/superpowers/specs/autoresearch-tasks/${task}.md" --autonomous --dry-run && forge reset --force && forge run --autonomous --yes
done

# Wave 2 (depends on Wave 1)
for task in T02-extract-prompt-files T05a-security-benchmarks T05b-architecture-benchmarks T05c-performance-benchmarks T05d-simplicity-benchmarks T12-results-tsv T14-git-integration; do
  forge implement "docs/superpowers/specs/autoresearch-tasks/${task}.md" --autonomous --dry-run && forge reset --force && forge run --autonomous --yes
done

# Wave 3
for task in T03-wire-into-dispatcher T06-finding-matcher-and-scorer T06b-benchmark-runner T08-wire-judge-into-scorer; do
  forge implement "docs/superpowers/specs/autoresearch-tasks/${task}.md" --autonomous --dry-run && forge reset --force && forge run --autonomous --yes
done

# Wave 4
forge implement docs/superpowers/specs/autoresearch-tasks/T11-single-experiment.md --autonomous --dry-run && forge reset --force && forge run --autonomous --yes

# Wave 5
forge implement docs/superpowers/specs/autoresearch-tasks/T13-full-loop-orchestration.md --autonomous --dry-run && forge reset --force && forge run --autonomous --yes
```

**Key notes:**
- Council is already enabled in `.forge/forge.toml` — no extra flag needed
- `--dry-run` generates spec + phases without the interactive approval prompt
- `--force` on reset clears stale phase completion state
- `--autonomous` gives Claude full edit permissions
- `--yes` auto-approves iteration prompts during execution
- Tasks within a wave are independent but share `.forge/phases.json`, so they must run sequentially (or you'd need separate `--project-dir` for true parallelism)
